a:
Create ONE production-ready transparent PNG game UI overlay: a spectacular BLUE DOKKAEBI FIRE FRAME for a cute Korean guardian's transformation introduction in a mobile Flutter app. It is an EMPTY FRAME, NOT a character illustration or a filled portal.

Canvas portrait 2:3, ideally 1024x1536. Camera straight on, orthographic frontal view, no tilted perspective. Centered large empty rectangular video aperture, 3:4 width-to-height, roughly x=12%..88%, y=16%..84% of the full canvas. The aperture and EVERYTHING outside the frame must be REAL FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, no black fill, no colored interior, no checkerboard painted into the image. The transparent opening must occupy most of the image and have almost square corners with a tiny softened bevel; it will reveal an existing 3:4 video underneath. Leave 5% clear outer safety margin so no flame tips are clipped.

Design: a very slim fixed sculpted midnight-indigo / cobalt rim with softly rounded tactile 3D bevel, subtle Korean cloud-scroll relief, clearly visible recessed inner wall, tiny azure reflected light along the inner edge. Not a thick heavy picture frame. No big pediment, no base plinth. The rim reads as a dimensional window lip. Vivid magical blue fire wraps around the four edges, overlaps itself in foreground and background, and rises upward. Flame shapes are plump fluid curling S-shaped Dokkaebi ghost flames with rounded spiral centers, matching a polished cute 3D Korean fantasy character: deep royal-blue roots, brilliant sky-blue/translucent cyan bodies, narrow white-hot cores, soft controlled bloom. They must look like sculptural flowing FIRE, not crystal/ice spikes, not smoke, not flat neon lines. Rich organic asymmetry in flame size, elegant curved tongues, a few isolated small round blue embers close to the rim. Front flames occlude small sections of the dark rim to create depth; rear blue flames peek from behind. Upper-left lighting, darker occluded creases and highlights make the rim tactile and 3-dimensional even at 340 px display width. Strong royal blue mass must remain visible on both pale and dark backgrounds. Keep major flame curls on the OUTER side of the aperture: video face and body need a quiet open center. A few tiny tongues may lap only 1-2% inward over the left/right rim to soften cropped video edges; no flames across the middle. Bottom flame band feels connected and upward flowing, not a flat platform.

This is phase A of a future three-image flame animation: fixed frame geometry and transparent aperture are invariant. Medium-high flame energy, balanced around perimeter, fluid lively curls. Premium handcrafted animated-feature quality with polished volumetric materials. No character, no face, no weapons, no scenery, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no orange/red fire, no black smoke, no devil motifs. Alpha-cutout asset ONLY, NOT a mockup or sheet, one empty frame.

Keep every major flame root anchored at exactly the same place and maintain very similar brightness, area and flame silhouettes, so crossfading phase A to B gives smooth movement with a motionless solid frame. Keep the large spiral flame at upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right and bottom center consistent; only flowing contours and tips evolve. Retain deep-blue roots, bright sky-blue bodies, white cores, small round blue embers, tactile polished volumetric fire. The clear center remains completely empty and transparent. No black fill, no painted checkerboard, no center mist. Do not let any flame touch canvas edges. No character, letters, text, logos, orange fire, smoke or ice shards. One transparent overlay asset.

Preserve the fixed dark cobalt carved rim, every rectangular aperture edge/corner, ornaments, bevels, exact location/scale, lighting, frontal camera and empty alpha hole. Soft sculptural 3D ghost-fire, sapphire roots, luminous cyan body, tiny white-hot cores, beautiful directional highlights. Preserve a broad quiet clear center for a character video.
